page_title: ROM 2-1 PAR | AS Roma v Parma 29/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Valerio Crezzini rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Enrico Delprato (Parma).
90+1' What was Christian Ordonez (Parma) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tjas Begic (Parma) will replace Sascha Britschgi.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' The AS Roma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
86' 2 - 1 Gooal! Alessandro Circati (Parma) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Adrian Benedyczak. He makes it 2:1.
85' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) replacing Wesley Franca.
85' Substitution. Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Gianluca Mancini walks off.
84' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Valerio Crezzini no option but to blow his whistle.
83' Great teamplay by Parma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
81' 2 - 0 Goal! Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
80' Parma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
78' Here is a change. Nahuel Estevez is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. Benjamin Cremaschi (Parma) for Adrian Bernabe Garcia.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Milan Djuric (Parma) is coming onto the pitch as Mateo Pellegrino cannot continue after picking up an injury.
76' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
76' Neat passing move from AS Roma in order to create new attacking opportunities.
73' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
73' Substitution. Matias Soule will be replaced by Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma).
72' Matias Soule (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Corner kick. AS Roma will have an opportunity.
72' AS Roma enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
70' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 7:1.
68' Matias Soule (AS Roma) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
67' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
65' Great teamplay by AS Roma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

64' 1 - 0 Goal! Paulo Dybala sent a fine cross from the corner kick. The perfect pass found Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) and his bullet header from around the penalty spot went straight into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
63' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
62' The resulting corner from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
61' Matias Soule (AS Roma) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play. AS Roma win a corner kick.
60' A substitution has been made. Patrick Cutrone is replaced by Adrian Benedyczak (Parma).
59' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
57' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
56' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
55' Matias Soule (AS Roma) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
53' AS Roma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

50' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Zion Suzuki thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
47' AS Roma control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' Here's the change. Leon Bailey leaves the pitch and Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) comes on as a substitute.
46' The whistle blows and Valerio Crezzini starts the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' The corner is swung in but AS Roma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

45+4' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Zion Suzuki dived superbly to block a header by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the roof of the net, but Zion Suzuki pulled off a remarkable save! AS Roma have a corner.
45+2' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+1' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Having seen unsporting behavior, Valerio Crezzini shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Mariano Troilo (Parma) is the recipient.
43' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The AS Roma players look gutted.
41' Wait! Referee Valerio Crezzini has indicated he is going to review the AS Roma goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
40' What a hit! Matias Soule (AS Roma) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
38' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
38' Leon Bailey (AS Roma) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the left post.
37' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Parma comes to nothing.
36' Christian Ordonez (Parma) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Mile Svilar makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
34' Manu Kone (AS Roma) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
33' The game is interrupted now, Manu Kone (AS Roma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
31' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
28' Neat passing move from Parma in order to create new attacking opportunities.
24' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
23' Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle after Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Parma win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
23' AS Roma enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
19' A dangerous looking corner kick from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is cleared to safety by the defence.
19' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AS Roma.
15' The Parma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
13' Christian Ordonez (Parma) sends a cross into the box, but Mile Svilar comes off his line to gather the ball.

11' That didn't go as planned! Wesley Franca (AS Roma) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Zion Suzuki, who easily kept it out.
9' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
7' Gian Piero Gasperini is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Evan Ferguson suffers an injury and Leon Bailey (AS Roma) comes on.
6' The Parma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
3' Matias Soule (AS Roma) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from AS Roma.
1' Dangerous play by Lautaro Valenti (Parma). Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Valerio Crezzini got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
